prompt: Write an email as the teaching assistant of the "Introduction to Computer Science" course, and tell the class that we will not be meeting this week.
response_text:
Subject: IMPORTANT: Class Cancellation - Introduction to Computer Science

Dear Students,

I am writing to inform you that our **Introduction to Computer Science** course will not be meeting for any lectures or lab sessions this week (Monday, [Date] – Friday, [Date]).

**Please take note of the following:**

*   **Assignments:** While we are not meeting in person, the deadline for [Assignment Name/Lab Number] remains [Date/Time]. Please ensure you submit your work via [Canvas/Moodle/Gradescope] as usual.
*   **Office Hours:** I will still be holding my regular office hours on [Day] at [Time] via [Zoom Link/Location] if you have any questions regarding the course material or upcoming projects.
*   **Readings:** I encourage you to use this time to get ahead on the readings for Chapter [Number], as we will be diving straight into that topic when we resume.

We will return to our regular schedule on **[Date of next class]**. 

If you have any urgent questions, please feel free to reach out to me via email. Thank you for your understanding, and have a productive week!

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Teaching Assistant
Introduction to Computer Science
[Your University]
